articles.summary: 13 Veterans, Gold Star Families and facilities that support veterans will receive a new roof or siding at no cost In honor of Veterans Day, QXO, Inc. (NYSE: QXO) announced today the launch of its annual QXO for Veterans initiative, honoring veterans, Gold Star Families and the communities that stand behind them. Now in its eighth year, the 2026 QXO for Veterans program is expanding beyond roofing to include siding. The 2026 program will provide 13 veterans, Gold Star Families and facilities that support veterans with property improvements at no cost. Each winner will receive a new roof or siding installed by local professionals using products from TRI-BUILT (r) , QXOs private label brand, and materials from CertainTeed , the 2026 exclusive program partner. QXOs commitment to serving veterans is one of the reasons I chose to join the company, said Sherri Leach, a U.S. Army veteran and vice president and deputy chief information security officer at QXO.
articles.title: QXO Expands Commitment to Veterans with 2026 QXO for Veterans Program

articles.summary: Ahuja to join QXO in January after a decade as CFO of Novelis QXO, Inc. (NYSE: QXO) today announced the appointment of Dev Ahuja as the companys Chief Financial Officer. He will succeed Ihsan Essaid, who has been promoted to Vice Chairman, an executive role, with both positions becoming effective in January 2027. Ahuja has more than two decades of experience leading financial operations for growth-oriented companies. He joins QXO from Novelis, a leading producer of innovative aluminum solutions, where he served as CFO since 2016. Previously, with healthcare giant Novartis, he held CFO roles for Alcon North America, Alcon Japan, and the companys South Korean business. Brad Jacobs, Chairman and Chief Executive Officer of QXO, said, Dev has led global finance teams through major capital transactions and the integration of key acquisitions.
